sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.verified: CV-death HR is reported (~0.80), but the extractor clause-bound it to the all-cause-death sentence
sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.not_pooled_because: ambiguous source attribution (all-cause vs CV-death sentence); and CV death is already a component of the pooled composite primary. Dropped rather than shipped ambiguous.

sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.verified: PIONEER-HF harm counts are in CT.gov structured results
sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.not_pooled_because: PIONEER-HF enrolled ACUTE decompensated HF with in-hospital initiation — out of scope for this chronic-HFrEF topic. Dropped.

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.verified: 28-day mortality 6/16 vs 2/14, exact counts in the committed abstract
corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.not_pooled_because: n=30, stopped early; pooling it with RECOVERY's rate ratio produces a scale-mismatched IRR+OR combination and an uninformative interval (RR 1.30, 95% CI 0.0002-6827). Honest k=1 (RECOVERY) is preferred over an inflated, garbage k=2.

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.verified: 28-day mortality is reported in each trial's full text (CoDEX 85/151 vs 91/148; Metcovid 72/194 vs 76/199)
corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.not_pooled_because: those counts are in the publisher full text (JAMA/OUP), not in our committed cached abstract, and the publisher pages are access-blocked, so the numbers cannot be self-verified against a committed source. Refused rather than pool on an unverifiable fetch.

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.verified: REMAP-CAP reports in-hospital mortality; CAPE-COVID reports day-21 mortality
corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.not_pooled_because: neither reports the declared 28-day all-cause mortality in its publication; the comparator (WHO REACT) used investigator-supplied 28-day data not present in the papers.

spironolactone-hfref-mortality.verified: all-cause mortality RR 0.87 (0.79-0.95), 478 vs 554 deaths, extracts cleanly
spironolactone-hfref-mortality.not_pooled_because: EPHESUS enrolled ACUTE post-myocardial-infarction LV dysfunction, which this topic's preregistered population_none excludes (chronic HFrEF only). A preregistered scope exclusion, not a miss; the comparator's inclusion of it is a scope difference.

colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis.verified: the comparator (Imazio 2012) pools these older colchicine pericarditis RCTs; we ran the FDA/EMA + registry adapters against the gap
colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis.not_pooled_because: MEASURED REACH WALL: CORE and COPE (2005) predate trial registries and are not FDA/EMA trials, so they are unreachable via openFDA/ISRCTN/EU-CTR/ICTRP. Colchicine is generic (no pivotal FDA approval file). The only reach for these is bibliographic (citation chasing from the comparator's reference list) — being built.

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention.not_pooled_because: the abstract reports 'events' (ambiguous recurrent-vs-patient) with no HR/CI and a broader composite (mortality+ACS+revascularisation+stroke) than a 3-point MACE; refused on ambiguity.
non-standard composite including decompensated heart failure; small, low-quality reporting; estimand mismatch.
this is a 30-day peri-PCI SECONDARY composite (the trial's primary is PCI-related myocardial injury); wrong timepoint/scope for secondary CV prevention.

omega3-cardiovascular-events.trial: DART, GISSI-Prevenzione, JELIS, GISSI-HF (comparator's large reach-gap trials)
omega3-cardiovascular-events.verified: FDA/EMA + multi-registry (ISRCTN/EU-CTR/ICTRP) adapters were built and run against these gaps
omega3-cardiovascular-events.not_pooled_because: MEASURED REACH WALL: these are old published RCTs (1989-2008) that predate the registries and are not FDA/EMA approval trials, so none is reachable via openFDA, Drugs@FDA, ISRCTN, EU-CTR or ICTRP. The FDA adapter reaches only newer approval-label trials (e.g. REDUCE-IT, which we already pool). Registry-and-regulatory reach does NOT cover older literature; the lever for these is citation-chasing of the comparator's own reference list, not a regulatory adapter.

noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke.verified: stroke/SE located: high-dose edoxaban HR 0.79 (on-treatment) and HR 0.87 (intention-to-treat), both with 97.5% CIs; low-dose 1.07/1.13
noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke.not_pooled_because: multi-dose (high/low) AND multi-analysis (on-treatment vs ITT) AND non-95% (97.5%) CIs. Which arm/analysis to pool is not unambiguous, and mixing a 97.5% CI into a 95%-CI pool is a subtle error; refused pending a pre-specified dose+analysis rule rather than pick one to reach parity.

noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke.verified: we pool dabigatran 110 mg stroke/SE RR 0.91
noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke.not_pooled_because: (refinement, not a refusal) 150 mg is the primary licensed stroke-prevention dose (RR 0.66); the arm choice should be pinned by a pre-specified rule. The 110 mg value is real and verified, but a dose-selection rule is queued.

iv-iron-hfref-hosp.verified: total HF hospitalisations located (e.g. AFFIRM-AHF 217 vs 294)
iv-iron-hfref-hosp.not_pooled_because: these are RECURRENT-EVENT totals (rate ratios), not patients-with->=1-event; pooling them as a binomial 2x2 would over-count. Estimand mismatch with the count-based pool.
FAIR-HF reports only PGA/NYHA (no HF-hospitalisation counts); EFFECT-HF is open-label with peak-VO2 as primary and no HF-hospitalisation result. Named data/outcome gaps.
